invariants.rationale: The method always returns a List produced from bulkInsert, which should never be null.
The bulkInsert helper always returns a List (specifically List<WriteStatus>); the result type is ensured.
Each input record can produce at most one WriteStatus in most clustering strategies, so the result list size cannot exceed inputRecords.
The number of write statuses should not exceed the number of output groups if positive.
If there are input records, clustering should return some WriteStatus, not an empty result list.
